correctness.rationale: The six allowed oriented edges of a triangle split into label-1 edges (0,1),(1,0) and label-2 edges (0,2),(2,0),(1,2),(2,1). Exact ending-count transitions (a,b)->(a,0) or (b,2a) give \(M_2^2\)=2I; the source counts at 0 and 1 agree at every time. Interior 2-runs between 1 observations are feasible precisely at even lengths. Pair-removal and four base outputs derive the full multiplicity formula. Independent outer/interior run decompositions give the rational bivariate enumerator; specialization u=1 and Fibonacci algebra give \(F_{m+3}-1\). All-2 fibers follow M_2 parity; inequalities prove unique maximum and finite base forms prove exact minimum multiplicities. The embedded stdlib verifier exhaustively compares 98,298 proper sources and tests distributions through 100, but finite checks do not replace the all-length proof.

originality.rationale: MacDonald (2022) supplies a general subshift embedding theorem for factor maps, but it neither determines finite-block inverse-fiber counts nor the exact finite zero-error code under the given map. The exact statement concerning indexed pairwise maxima of unequal-neighbor ternary words was compared to primary substring-reconstruction, DNA-constrained coding and group-invariant max-filtering publications, and to semantically retrieved nearby indexed claims. None of the examined claims proves or implies the exact admissible-output criterion, all-fiber enumeration or complete bivariate histogram. Only a qualified priority assessment is justified.
